pages.title: Rain Shelter House Escape
pages.creator: GamesPoint
pages.description: Find a way out of a locked roadside home in Rain Shelter House Escape. Explore rooms, collect items, and interpret clues while a dog guards another exit. Solve puzzles to wake its sleeping owner and get the help needed to leave.

pages.title: Color Cube Puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Feed colored shapes from conveyors in Color Cube Puzzle. Move each shape beside cubes of its matching color so it fills up and disappears. Plan how to position the remaining shapes, clearing all of them to finish the level.

pages.title: INCOWORD
pages.creator: FOLD WAR inc
pages.description: Decode sound-alike phrases in INCOWORD. Read the gibberish aloud to hear the hidden word, then type your answer. Flip the clue card for help, choose different word lengths for solo play, or race friends in a real-time multiplayer room.

pages.title: Crunch Locked
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fold connected segments together in Crunch Locked. Tap an available part to rotate it ninety degrees and bring the structure closer to completion. Choose a sequence that avoids blocked or locked sections until the final remaining piece clears away.

pages.title: Burger Here
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Grow a restaurant business in Burger Here. Prepare orders, collect payment, clean tables, and hire staff to handle the workload. Upgrade employees and expand into additional restaurants while keeping the burger service organized for arriving customers.

pages.title: Obby Parkour Racing
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Race on a snowboard in Obby Parkour Racing. Jump, grind, and dodge through obstacle courses while aiming to finish ahead of the competition. Move with WASD, jump with the spacebar, and use a speed boost when its bonus is active.

pages.title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Link matching icons in Mojicon Emoji Connect. Connect each pair with a route that turns no more than twice and clear the board before time expires. Hints and shuffles help with difficult layouts as you work toward earning stars.

pages.title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Run a food-focused broadcast in ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang. Shop for ingredients, cook dishes, and eat them while engaging with viewers. The game ties your meal preparation and livestream activity to the money the character earns.

pages.title: Lovely Cat Pet Life
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Customize a kitten's world in Lovely Cat Pet Life. Dress the pet in different outfits and use creative choices to build its appearance. Minigames add activities alongside the cat-themed styling and do-it-yourself elements.

pages.title: Timewalker: Survive!
pages.creator: GOECORUSH Media, s. r. o.
pages.description: Battle undead crowds across different eras in Timewalker: Survive!. Move through top-down environments, aim and fire at approaching zombies, and reload between attacks. A slow-motion ability adds another tool as the waves become more intense.

pages.title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Fly through hazards in Geometry Vibes X-Ball. Hold the control to rise and release it to dive, steering around traps and gears. Explore challenge levels or share the screen in modes supporting up to four players.

pages.title: Squid Game 3D
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Work through varied challenges in Squid Game 3D. Click or drag objects to complete puzzles that combine timing, strategic decisions, and construction tasks. Later levels increase the complexity, asking you to adjust your approach to each new objective.

pages.title: Pirate Noob Apocalypse
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Defend a pirate ship against undead attackers in Pirate Noob Apocalypse. Aim at enemies climbing toward the vessel and earn coins from the fight. Spend those coins on ship upgrades to strengthen the defense against subsequent assaults.

pages.title: Poppy Player Puzzle
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Reach the keys needed to free a captive doll in Poppy Player Puzzle. Drag the character's hand through the maze and use buttons that affect the level's traps. Plan the route around those mechanisms to complete the rescue.

pages.title: Mutant run
pages.creator: Sixcube
pages.description: Choose animal transformations to overcome a changing obstacle course in Mutant run. Guide the runner through mutation gates that grant different creatures' talents. Match those abilities to the barriers ahead as you steer along the track.

pages.title: Highway Bus Rush
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Pilot a bus through crowded roads in Highway Bus Rush. Weave between traffic and handle obstacles along an ongoing highway journey. Keyboard driving controls, a handbrake, and adjustable camera views help you manage the large vehicle at speed.

pages.title: My Sweet Strawberry Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create fruit-inspired fashion in My Sweet Strawberry Outfits. Help a group of friends choose clothes for their strawberry-themed weekend looks. Coordinate makeup with the selected outfits to finish each character's version of the shared idea.

pages.title: Design With Me Cute Tie Dye Tops
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create personalized shirts in Design With Me Cute Tie Dye Tops. Pick a crop-top shape, fabric colors, and a pattern, then add an inscription. Pair the finished top with a skirt or shorts to complete each friend's holiday outfit.

pages.title: Kaiten Sushi
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Help a sushi chef prepare nigiri in Kaiten Sushi. Watch the fish arriving on the screen and press its corresponding button at the right moment. The challenge is to keep choosing the correct icon as the preparation sequence continues.

pages.title: Train Lines Rush
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Collect passengers along a railway route in Train Lines Rush. Drag the train around obstacles and bring its growing group of customers to the destination station. Earn money to unlock more items and improve the train between trips.

pages.title: Real Simulator Monster Truck
pages.description: Drive large vehicles across open maps in Real Simulator Monster Truck. Buy and develop trucks, compete against computer drivers in races, or tackle stunt routes. Nitro and adjustable camera views support the different driving challenges.

pages.title: Monster Cars: Ultimate Simulator
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose a powerful vehicle in Monster Cars: Ultimate Simulator and explore its varied handling. Try time attacks, circuit races, flying races, and other challenges. Separate controls allow a second player to join the driving competition.

pages.title: Noob vs Zombies
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Defeat block-world enemies with a hammer in Noob vs Zombies. Choose attacks so the hammer's path intersects the skeletons, creepers, and other threats. Each encounter asks you to line up the trajectory before committing to the strike.

pages.title: Stack Crash Ball
pages.creator: Mak Game Hub
pages.description: Break through revolving platforms in Stack Crash Ball. Hold to speed the ball's descent through colored sections, but avoid black surfaces that shatter it. Sustained action can create a fireball powerful enough to smash through otherwise dangerous layers.

pages.title: Riot Escape
pages.creator: YSO Corp
pages.description: Push through a guarded course in Riot Escape. Play as a runner trying to pass police and obstacles on the way to the finish, or switch roles and stop the escapees. Move through the crowd while pursuing your side's objective.

pages.title: Rails and Stations
pages.creator: Pushin Games
pages.description: Gather resources and connect trading points in Rails and Stations. Cut trees, mine iron, and sell goods to build more railroad. Hire helpers to speed collection and use dynamite to open blocked routes as the explored world expands.

pages.title: Heels Stacky Rush 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build up your footwear in Heels Stacky Rush 3D. Collect heel sections while running along elevated tracks, then spend their height to cross block walls. Steer toward useful pickups so the stack remains tall enough for the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: SciFi Flight Simulator
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Pilot an aircraft through obstacle courses in SciFi Flight Simulator. Use the arrow keys to avoid objects and complete each level. The flight challenge focuses on choosing a safe route through the structures ahead rather than colliding with them.

pages.title: Fools Match
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Select groups of matching faces in Fools Match. Move three same-colored pieces from the lower arrangement to the top so they disappear. The order of your selections matters, requiring you to plan which colors to collect next.

pages.title: Princesses Halloween Getup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress three friends for a fashionable holiday celebration in Princesses Halloween Getup. Choose outfits and accessories for Clara, Sophie, and Emma. Their preferred looks emphasize contemporary Halloween fashion, giving you a wardrobe to coordinate for each princess.

pages.title: Pigeons Pigeons
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Aim a shotgun at bird targets in Pigeons Pigeons. Watch the moving sight and fire when it lines up with a pigeon. The shooting challenge depends on choosing the right instant rather than wasting a shot before the viewfinder reaches its target.

pages.title: Garden Tales 2
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Complete fruit-matching tasks in Garden Tales 2. Swap pieces to make groups of at least three and meet each level's goals. Longer matches create boosters, helping you clear harder boards as you advance along the garden map.

pages.title: Ice Man 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Use freezing powers against attackers in Ice Man 3D. Control an icy superhero and overwhelm the enemies threatening the city. The game centers on applying those powers to stop opponents and break them apart during the encounters.

pages.title: Spot the Difference Animals
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find small changes between animal scenes in Spot the Difference Animals. Select each alteration to mark it with a circle and continue comparing the pictures. Three incorrect clicks end the game, making careful observation more useful than guessing.

pages.title: Animal Puzzles
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Rebuild animal pictures in Animal Puzzles by exchanging image sections. Drag pieces into different positions until the complete illustration is restored. Twelve puzzles offer new animals to assemble, each under a time limit that keeps the rearranging moving.

pages.title: Western Escape
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Draw a safe path for cowboys in Western Escape. Guide them toward the target while keeping the line clear of spikes, lasers, tanks, and patrolling enemies. When a route is tight, controlling the pace helps them pass the dangerous sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Mermaids Coloring Book Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Color unusual sea characters in Kawaii Mermaids Coloring Book Game. Choose from mermaids inspired by creatures such as sharks, rays, and jellyfish, alongside more familiar designs. Apply your preferred colors to create an individual version of each outlined picture.

pages.title: Police Stick man wrestling Fighting Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Fight for a wrestling victory in Police Stick man wrestling Fighting Game. Move the character with the arrow keys and use Z, X, and C for attacks. Combine movement with the available fighting actions to defeat opponents in the ring.

pages.title: Join Clash 3d
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a squad while moving through Join Clash 3d. Shoot barrels to free and collect more soldiers, then avoid obstacles that reduce your group. Reach the final monster attack with enough surviving fighters to overcome the enemies emerging from the caves.

pages.title: Pregnant Princess Caring
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Complete family-care activities in Pregnant Princess Caring. Help with the princess's food and checkup, decorate a baby room, and tend to the child after arrival. The sequence includes baby-care tasks such as bathing and preparing a bottle.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle Deluxe
pages.creator: Latimed
pages.description: Fit clusters of hexagons into the empty board in Hexa Puzzle Deluxe. Drag each piece into a position that fills the gaps without leaving an unresolved space. Work through different difficulty levels as the layouts require more careful arrangement.

pages.title: Beat Line
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow a fast musical course in Beat Line. Tap to turn sharply at the right moments and collect crystals along the route. Spend the crystals to unlock alternative objects, including unusual shapes that replace the moving character.

pages.title: Tap Tap Ball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Change a football's direction with timed taps in Tap Tap Ball. Keep following the road and collect flags during the run. Use those flags to purchase additional teams as you work on extending your progress along the route.

pages.title: Bus Parking 3D
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Maneuver a large passenger vehicle into position in Bus Parking 3D. Use the keyboard to steer and the spacebar to brake as you approach the parking area. The challenge centers on controlling the bus accurately through each parking task.

pages.title: Classic Car Parking Challenge
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Practice parking vintage vehicles in Classic Car Parking Challenge. Follow driving missions that test steering and placement rather than racing. Use the arrow keys to adjust the car's approach and guide it into the required position.

pages.title: Classic Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Remove identical tile pairs in Classic Mahjong Deluxe. Select only pieces that are uncovered and have at least one open side. Clear the layout across thirty levels and try to finish each board with a three-star result.

pages.title: Choli Climb
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Climb mountain platforms in Choli Climb using normal and double jumps. Cross holes without falling and collect clocks to extend the time available. Reaching higher ground requires managing both the platform gaps and the countdown.

pages.title: Cute Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Free trapped birds in Cute Bubble Shooter by clearing groups of matching bubbles. Aim and release shots to join at least three of the same color. Play structured levels for stars or try the separate endless mode.

pages.title: Archery Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help a couple kiss discreetly in Archery Kissing. Watch the surrounding forest characters and animals, choosing moments when they are not looking. Stop the kiss before anyone notices to preserve the couple's secret meeting.

pages.title: Defuse the Bomb : Secret Mission
pages.creator: Hermit Crab Game Studio
pages.description: Follow urgent instructions in Defuse the Bomb : Secret Mission. Complete the required actions before the countdown reaches zero and the device explodes. After learning Regular Mission mode, try Impossible Mission, which places more emphasis on remembering the procedure.

pages.title: Hard Glass
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reveal temporary support beneath a moving ball in Hard Glass. Tap at the right moment to make the invisible glass appear and prevent a fall. Acting too early can still leave the ball unsupported, making precise timing central to keeping the run alive.

pages.title: Real Moto Bike Race Game Highway 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Race motorcycles on busy routes in Real Moto Bike Race Game Highway 2020. Choose control and camera options, earn credits, and unlock bikes, paint choices, and tracks. Two racing modes provide different settings for improving your riding performance.

pages.title: GunGame Paintball Wars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Compete in paintball-themed combat in GunGame Paintball Wars. Choose multiplayer or campaign activities, including team battles, free-for-all encounters, and zombie challenges. Move, aim, and fire through the selected mode while managing the threats around your character.

pages.title: Cube Bike Speed Runner
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Steer through a fast-moving course in Cube Bike Speed Runner. Shift the motorcycle left or right to avoid objects on the road. Keep finding a clear path as you try to preserve the run without hitting an obstacle.

pages.title: Mini Superhero Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Assemble cartoon hero pictures in Mini Superhero Jigsaw. Select one of twelve illustrations and choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece puzzle. Place the sections together to finish the image, increasing the piece count when you want a harder arrangement.

pages.title: Backflip Parkour
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Perform aerial tricks in Backflip Parkour. Launch from high positions and rotate through flips or backflips during the jump. The simulator focuses on executing those acrobatic movements as you work through its parkour-style trick challenges.

pages.title: Toilet Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Find a route to the bathroom in Toilet Rush. Move and jump through puzzle-platform stages before the character's urgent situation becomes a disaster. The objective is to reach the toilet by working out how to cross the level in time.

pages.title: Monster Truck Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Remember vehicle cards in Monster Truck Memory. Reveal pictures and select their matching partners until the board is clear. Completing the arrangement with fewer clicks improves the score, rewarding careful use of the positions you have already seen.

pages.title: My Zombie Driving Apocalypse
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive through an undead wasteland in My Zombie Driving Apocalypse. Shoot zombies ahead of the vehicle and collect aids such as shields and nitro. Different cars have their own abilities, giving you more options as you work to extend the survival run.

pages.title: Horse Ride Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a horse through races in Horse Ride Racing. Press forward to increase speed and use the spacebar to jump. Choose from different horse appearances and time the jumps as you work through the riding challenge.

pages.title: Falling Blocks
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description: Remove hostile pieces without losing the friendly one in Falling Blocks. Click away the angry blocks and account for how the remaining arrangement moves under gravity. Thirty physics puzzles combine planning with timing to keep the happy block alive.

pages.title: Monster Jump
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help a creature climb in Monster Jump. Move with the keyboard arrows and guide its jumps toward higher positions. The goal is to gain as much height as possible while keeping the monster's ascent going.

pages.title: Cube Fall
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Steer a free-falling character through danger in Cube Fall. Avoid obstacles and collect rewards during the descent. Those rewards unlock improved equipment and additional characters, giving you new options as you work on surviving farther through the course.

pages.title: Battle Bricks Puzzle Online
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Compete against another player in Battle Bricks Puzzle Online. Move falling block pieces into complete lines and use your clearing progress to knock out the opponent. The puzzle combines arranging your own board with keeping up in a direct contest.

pages.title: Racing Cars Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Customize illustrated vehicles in Racing Cars Coloring Book. Choose a car picture and apply paint using the brush and available colors. Build your own version of the design, selecting a different palette for each part of the racing car.

pages.title: Hover Racer Pro
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pilot high-speed hovercraft in Hover Racer Pro. Steer, brake, and boost while competing against computer-controlled ships. Watch the craft's condition as collisions cause damage, and adjust the handling to keep the vehicle moving through the course.

pages.title: Masked Forces
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight enemies in Masked Forces across a single-player campaign and online modes. Use the available weapons to eliminate the opposition and keep your character alive. The different activities let you tackle combat alone or enter matches with other players.

pages.title: Watercraft Rush
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Race a personal watercraft in Watercraft Rush. Steer around obstacles and finish all the required laps before time runs out. Three worlds each contain tracks of increasing difficulty, giving you a succession of timed aquatic courses.

pages.title: Tap Tap Plane
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Tap to keep an aircraft flying in Tap Tap Plane. Maintain its altitude, avoid obstacles, and try to travel farther before the run ends. Progress also leads toward unlocking five hidden features that change the experience.

pages.title: Sky Glider
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Pilot a wing glider above the water in Sky Glider. Gather coins while keeping away from other gliders sharing the airspace. Spend the collected currency on improvements to your glider as you continue working on longer flights.

pages.title: Stickman Fighter: Epic Battles
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fight waves of opponents in Stickman Fighter: Epic Battles. Control the stick-figure hero and defeat the warriors entering the arena. The objective is to overcome every enemy, keeping your fighter alive as the confrontations continue.

pages.title: Kardashians Spooky Makeup
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create seasonal face-paint designs in Kardashians Spooky Makeup. Help the characters prepare Halloween looks by applying the available makeup choices. Coordinate the colors and details into finished spooky designs for their holiday celebration.

pages.title: Gun Zombies
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Defend yourself against attacking undead in Gun Zombies. Keep shooting while the zombies try to reach you, aiming to survive as long as possible. The challenge centers on holding off the attackers and extending the current survival attempt.

pages.title: Cash Grab
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Time a dangerous reach for money in Cash Grab. Take the cash without losing a hand to the trap, choosing a safe moment for each attempt. Build your winnings while protecting the limited chances available to your character.

pages.title: Music Line v1
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Follow a moving course in Music Line v1. Change the line's direction at the right moments to stay on the route. The music-themed challenge rewards accurate timing as you guide the character through its turns.

pages.title: Shooting Heads
pages.creator: WI Games
pages.description: Battle other players in Shooting Heads, a two-dimensional arena shooter. Move around the platform-based level and aim at opponents while staying out of their fire. Use the arena's layout as you work to defeat the rival fighters.

pages.title: Valerian Space Run
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Run through alien environments in Valerian Space Run. Shift left or right, jump over obstacles, and slide beneath barriers as the agent travels through the galaxy. Keep choosing the required movement to avoid the hazards along the route.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die Christmas Party
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Protect a cast of accident-prone creatures in Silly Ways To Die Christmas Party. React to their hazardous holiday situations with the mouse and keep them alive. Each festive predicament asks you to act before the celebration turns fatal.

pages.title: Elsa and Anna Beach Selfie
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare two sisters for holiday pictures in Elsa and Anna Beach Selfie. Choose swimsuits and hairstyles, then add beach drinks to their looks. Once both characters are dressed, they can pose for the selfies that finish their seaside outing.
